_about: Invented for the Familiar demo. A bare card: the host knows Walter's name and the year he died. Our guess waits on the card for one tap.
title: When was Walter Pike born?
summary: Nobody told Walter's year of birth; he married Helena, born in 1925.

versions.label: About 1922, a few years older than his wife

for.text: Helena was born in 1925 and they were one generation; nobody remembers a great difference in age.
